reviews.text:
It has taken som time for me to write this review because my experience with Alessando Pet Spa still makes me anxious and I don't want to think about it but I think people should know.
The place is very cute and nice and clean and the people there are really nice. My main concern was how their communication was handled that caused a lot of anxiety for me and my cats. A few things..
1. I brought my first cat out of 4 in for grooming and asked that they do a lion cut but leaving the tail. I stayed to see them get started as they shave off the tale which I specifically asked that they leave. This is not too crazy of a deal, I got very upset because I felt I can't trust leaving my cats there and they said they felt very bad and gave me a discount which I appreciated.

2. I took three more cats in the next day and they told me they would Facetime me to make sure they got the cut right which I appreciated considering what happened the day before.
However, they didn't call and I just assumed they had decided to go off the pictures I had sent them. Then Alessandro calls me 2,5 hours(!!) after drop off. Had I known I would have picked them up and left. This resulted in one of my cats getting super anxious to the point where they couldn't finish groomig him. I had to pick him up early, half groomed AND they charged me not just the full price but an additional "spicy cat fee" even though we never had any problem with this cat before, or after taking him to Alessandro. I think I was a little bit chocked to think this through there and then. At the same time Alessandro sent pictures of how my cat had scratched the groomer which, I feel bad for. But why on earth would they let cats sit around in an unknown space for 2,5 hours to then groom them? That's torture for a cat which I would expect that they know. It still makes me anxious to think about my cats experience while with the past groomers and the one now we have 0 problem with him.

3. They don't (or at least not at the time) share their pricing on their website or anywhere. When I talked to the girl working there before taking them in she said a lion cut for 1 cat was $180. She also said if bringing 4 cats in I would get a discount. As I was going to pay the cost, Alessandro meant that the price was $240 per cat but that I would still get a discount. I would never have taken them there for $240 in the first place. (And I send pictures of the cats so the employe and him both had the same information.) . On top of that they had me pay the spicy cat extra fee for the anxiety they caused my to my cat even though he was half groomed.
Again, they all were very nice and Alessandro felt super bad about getting the cut wrong due to miscommunication with his employee.
What I don't appreciate is  the huge lack of communication with me and between employees for what cut to give and what the actual price is. And the worst part - not letting me know the cats would wait around to the point they got super anxious. I was so anxious from this whole experience that I didn't want to see them and even less fight over the price. I just wanted my babies out of there.

After talking to other groomers something I learnt is that some groomers apparently double book clients in case there's a flake or last minute which I assumed is what happened here because he couldn't explain why they waited even thought I said I could take them in one by one because i lived close.

Lastly, we got two cat carriers as a first time costumer gift which I thought was sweet. One of them broke within 2 weeks, luckily not with a cat in it so I wouldn't recommend take one if they offer it.
Finally, I will say that 2 out of the 4 cats turned out looking good but where I go now I get all of the looking great and for a much better price and they are never anxious when leaving or picking them up.

Rude.
Called to ask about information to groom a cat and they sounded annoyed with my questions.

Hi! As the owner of a dog rescue and so many different dogs that come in and out needing grooming - Alessandro is the BEST and truly cares about each and every clients wellbeing. We recommend coming here for ALL of our alumni and definitely for your baby!! Fantastic job done and humans!!!
Amazing - this is the only groomer my dog has ever liked!

I truly cannot say enough amazing things about Alessandro Pet Spa! Blanco and Luna always come home looking absolutely PERFECT — clean, fluffy, beautifully groomed, and smelling amazing. 🐾🤍

But what really makes this place so special to me is how incredible he is with Blanco. Blanco has a very sensitive trachea, so I’m extremely careful and honestly very particular about who I trust to handle and groom him. He is always so gentle, patient, attentive, and careful with Blanco, and that gives me such peace of mind. He understands that Blanco needs a little extra care and never makes me feel like it’s an inconvenience. Knowing that someone is taking his condition seriously and treating him like their own means more to me than I can explain.

He’s equally wonderful with Luna, and you can genuinely tell how much care and pride goes into every groom. They always come back looking like two perfect little Pomeranian show dogs 😂💕 Their faces are adorable, their coats are so fluffy, and every little detail looks beautiful.

Finding a groomer who does amazing work is one thing, but finding someone you completely trust with your babies — especially one who needs extra care — is priceless. I’m so grateful we found Alessandro Pet Spa, and I honestly wouldn’t trust Blanco and Luna with anyone else. 1000% recommend! 🐶✨🤍

First time client here! We just moved here from the big apple and asked around for a place in the West Hollywood area and came across Alessandro Pet Spa right on Melrose. 20 out of 10 in terms of the haircut I wanted for my boy but most of all how flexible Alessandro was for a last minute appointment. On top of that a cute little tie for my dog's glow-up A returning customer for sure :)

Came here for the first time yesterday To groom, my Show dog golden retriever.. The bather is fantastic. The groomer is also fabulous. Thank you for an incredible experience and you’ll be seeing us every two weeks.

I was quite dissatisfied with the service. From the moment I dropped my dog ​​off, I clearly explained how I wanted him to look, and I specifically indicated that I didn't want his hair cut too short, as I'd had a very bad experience before for that very reason.

When I went to pick him up, I was shocked to find that they had cut much more than I had requested. Furthermore, his hair was quite uneven and had a very different finish than what I had asked for.

I appreciate the 20% discount they offered, but I honestly consider the final result very disappointing. The most important thing for me was that they respected the instructions I gave from the beginning, especially since I clearly explained what I wanted to avoid.

I hope you will take this feedback into account to improve communication with customers and be more careful with specific instructions regarding pet haircuts.
Bruno looks amazing! Alessandro was patient with him, gave him breaks when needed, and did a great job with his groom!
Very happy dog :), thanks Alessandro!

Alessandro and his staff were amazing! Super nice and helpful and both of my dogs came home super soft & smelling great 🥰 they both tend to shed a lot and I’ve had a hard time finding a groomer who can de-shed them properly, but the team here did an amazing job and I will def be bringing them back! …
They did great work with my husky, awesome deshedding!! I recommend.

It’s taken me a few days but —please bring your dogs to Alessandro’s. He is so kind, loving and understanding of every dog. He doesn’t see dogs as a challenge but an opportunity to connect, help and bring joy.

My dog is a Yorkie and is not an ideal client. He doesn’t bite but he can get kennel aggressive and he does have some fear based reactivity.

I tried taking him to a different groomer and he was rejected for barking. Even still— I told Alessandro my dog’s history and he didn’t turn my pup away. Instead he was treated with care and openness.

When Alessandro first greeted my dog I let him know that while he won’t bite, he is aggressive. (He gets mean if he thinks you’re going to touch him.) Alessandro listened to me/read my dog’s body language and within minutes they got along.

The actual groom/haircut was amazing and my baby looked beautiful. But the real magic was my dog’s behavior after the appointment. It was clear that he had a good time/didn’t want to leave.

If you have the money for a quality cut/good experience please consider bringing your dog in.

Im including before and after pics of my dog. *I would also like to note that I’ve been dealing with chronic illness/a parent with late stage cancer. So I lapsed in my grooming responsibilities. My dog and I were treated with respect and kindness.*
I loved it! Alessandro is a wonderful person who treats you with so much love and does an excellent job. I'll be back!

Amazing groomer, trusted place, have been taking my Pom here for a while now and I’m always so picky with who I trust with his double coat. He comes out looking perfect and smelling so good every time.
First time service was amazing. They were so communicative and kind. My cat came out looking and smelling great! And with a new piece of jewelry :) Will definitely be back.

Alessandro is the perfect groomer for my baby girl. She was looking kind of raggedy when I brought her in and he explained what we could do during a brief consultation and also made some very valuable suggestions! I loved his demeanor and the vibe of the shop. I called on a Thursday to get an appointment and was given an opening on Friday afternoon by Loree, who was also really friendly and helpful! In a city where dog groomers change jobs every five minutes it’s comforting to know that we can come back here and get the same expert service again and again. My baby has a fresh summer cut, and there are a lot of extras included in the price. We will definitely be back!

Nothing but good experiences with our multiple visits to APS.  Super friendly.  They're very considerate for the pooch's well being and do a fine job.  Zero attitude which we have oddly encountered at a high end "boutique" place - go figure.   We like the location which is also a plus.  I'm sure there are places as good however you won't find one better and pooch never looked so good!

My mini schnauzer can be so nervous and he gets the best grooming and pet care I’ve ever seen. Always amazing and perfect hair cuts and the staff is very kind and makes my pup and I feel comfortable. Very affordable and excellent grooming care! Never seen my dog so handsome before until I went here ☺️

Doesn’t the photograph say at all?! This  Is the best grooming salon for your dog and cat! Ella just got her summer cut from Maglen! The fabulous Alessandro is right there in the middle! He is a  gem and a total pro! PS: Ella RUNS into their arms!
We spent a year and a half trying different groomers to find one who could do justice to our Maltese.  We just got her back from Alessandro and she was trimmed to perfection.  We will look no more.

My grooming place  closed down about a year ago and I've been dragging my dog to other grooming places since. I haven't done a good job. They haven't done a complete job. And my girls never felt better after she got groomed. And then I found Alessandro. This groomer, I got to tell you, this groomer is so sweet, compassionate, has such deep love for the dogs. And I'm sure the cats that go in there too. He did such a magnificent job on my dog, she's 16, but now she skips around like she's 10 years old again. She's so happy. The shampoo he used was perfect for her skin, the cut he gave her was just beautiful. Not too long not too sure but for her enough to feel free in her own coat. He will be my forever groomer. I can't think of anybody who I would refer to more. Just take your dog, or your cat if he takes cats, and go see him. He's on Melrose so he's centrally located and, he's just the best I've ever met up with! Thank you, Alessandro! XO Shawn.

Alessandro's grooming service was incredible. From calling for the first consult all the way to the time i got him, the customer service from him and his team was amazing. Obviously getting a cat groomed is no easy task, but I am so happy with how my cat's lion cut turned out. I believe my cat was treated with patience and with a gentle touch for his bath and his grooming service. It's really hard to find GOOD cat groomers who know how to handle cats and also give a cute cut! I am so happy with the services I will 10000% be bringing my cat in as a regular customer!
I have a long haired cat so the whole process took about 3.5-4 hours as expected. Plenty of street parking on melrose. Also so many cute things in the shop! I was also gifted a cute cat toy when we were done. Highly recommend!

Our first time here.  We went as walk ins and they were able to fit us in which I really appreciated. They left my girl looking so beautiful. The staff is so friendly and welcoming. I’m so happy and grateful we found a new groomer

HORRIBLE. TOOK MY DOG IN FOR ANAL GLAD EXPRESSION 3 DAYS AGO AND SHE'S BEEN A MESS EVER SINCE. SCOOTING AND LICKING--WHATEVER THEY DID MADE IT WORSE. SO---- I called and nicely asked for a manager to ask some questions....the vet does internal, groomers do external--is it normal to scoot and lick incessantly afterwards? I heard that they can get impacted again sometimes.... Well not sure who got on the phone, but he had an accent and couldn't be ruder. I simply and nicely asked if he was a manager and he jumped down my throat and wouldn't answer...insisting on knowing who I was. It's very easy to say "YES- WHAT'S UP?" or "YES, MY NAME IS..... HOW CAN I HELP YOU?"   But not this rude jerk. DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME GOING TO THIS RUDE PLACE--- AND ALL THE WHILE, MY POOR DOG IS WORSE THAN WHEN I CAME IN.

I cannot say enough amazing things about Alessandro Pet Spa. My little Bruno just had a full grooming, and I am beyond impressed with the level of care, attention, kindness and professionalism we received. When I picked Bruno up, he looked absolutely incredible, clean, perfectly groomed, and so happy. You can truly tell that Alessandro and his team take pride in their work and genuinely care about every pet that comes through the doors. Bruno’s coat is soft, shiny, and beautifully styled, and he smells amazing! Thank you, Alessandro.

I brought Remi to Alessandro.  He does AMAZING work.  He also is a very nice man.  Remi is often nervous at groomers, but she loved her time at Alessandro's!  Highly recommend for grooming and their other services.  Owner is definitely 'hands-on'! Fairly priced for the services they provide.

Today was the first time that I’ve visited Alessandro’s Pet Spa after trying other WeHo groomers. Not only were the staff and owner extremely easy to communicate with over the phone, they adjusted my appointment from one cat to both of my cats (one under the age of 1) same day.

My cats look and smell amazing, and the service was completed in less than 5hrs. I will be coming back— amazing prices as well.

Thank you Alessandro!

Ok - took Ruby in due to a streak of bad pooch grooming experiences.  Had a hunch this place might work.  They did a great work up - bath, grooming, cut, cleaning and tooth brushing - she ended up looking great.  Place was also super clean + very calm, something Ruby appreciates as she tacks on the years.  Price was great even without the surprise 1st time discount.  Plus the hood is a great area to walk & check out next time we're there. So, Yes - thanks for a great job and at being just shy of 15, she's never looked better!

I took my puppy to Alessandro for the first time last week, and Pumpkin was returned to me with a cut on his lip and a massive open wound on near his hindquarters. It was bleeding profusely when I picked him up. It was so deep that it was getting infected within a day, and the vet needed to put him under in order to administer stitches. To his credit, Alessandro was extremely apologetic. He refunded my money and immediately paid for the entire $770 vet bill. Nevertheless I've never heard of a dog getting hurt this badly from a groomer.

I brought my 6 month old Shih Tzu  looking so dirty with long unshaded long coat She came out looking like a show dog!!!
Thank you so much for the hard work.

So happy I found Alessandro. I have taken my Cavalier to many groomers, and prior to Alessandro, I had only found one that I really thought was great (in Austin, TX). Cavaliers have infamously difficult paws to cut, and he did them exactly how I wanted.

I was initially satisfied with the haircut and the price, and everything seemed fine when we picked our dog up. Unfortunately, not long after, we noticed him acting differently and scratching more than usual. Upon closer inspection, we found a raw scrape near his scrotal area that appeared related to shaving, as the hair there had clearly been trimmed.
We took him to the vet, who also discovered a significant cut inside his ear. The vet indicated it was consistent with a grooming injury, especially since that ear had noticeably shorter hair compared to the other.
I understand that minor injuries can happen during grooming, and that alone did not upset me. What was most disappointing was that none of these injuries were disclosed to us at pickup. Had we not been observant and taken him to the vet, these wounds could have become infected and caused serious issues. Transparency is extremely important when it comes to the safety and well-being of pets, and this lack of disclosure felt irresponsible. I would not recommend this groomer to anyone and we will definitely not be coming back.

I adopted a dog with behavioral issues 3 months ago and couldn't find any groomer who would accept my dog.
Thankfully, I was recommended by my colleague to Alessandro.
First of all, they are the nicest people I know, Alessandro and the spa.
The best of all, they care my dog, which I KNOW it needs lots of patience. Moreover, my dog always come home fresh, nice haircut, fluffy and smell amazing.
Thank you, Alessandro and Team!

Fantastic experience. I just rescued my new kitty last week from the shelter, and took him today in for a bath, claw-trimming, and toothbrushing. Kitty is a special case as he is healing from recently-removed skin cancer and removal of his ears, and the staff was understanding and totally accommodating. He came out relaxed and fluffy as a cloud, smelling incredible, with an adorable holiday bow! So impressed with the kindness of Alessandro and his team. Thank you for all that you do, from Morgan and Cielito (kitty!)

My dog came back happy from the groomer for the first time
amazing service!
Thank you!
Alessandro and his staff are always super friendly and treat my 2 dogs very well. We’re repeat customers. Highly recommend him for all your grooming needs.

We took our two cats to Alessandro for a minor flea infestation.  The staff was incredibly communicative and got us in next day.  They texted throughout the visit to let us know they provided soothing music and aromatherapy to calm our cats.  When we picked them up, they looked fabulous, smelled fresh, and their little claws had been done to perfection.  They sent our kitties home wearing a bow tie and a rose!!!  We were even provided a welcome gift.  We will be back!!!  Incredible service from a wonderful team!
Alessandro it’s absolutely amazing. This was our first time here and my dog absolutely loved it. He looks great and everyone was so nice. I recommend this place.

Luna and Nori love it here!  Alessandro and Lupa are kind, magnificent, compassionate, professional, just great people!   My fur babies have lots of fun and look great.  So much so, they nap when they get home.  Thank you thank you thank you for making my babies look fabulous and giving them care, kindness and treating them like family.   🥰💖🐕🐕

I recently took my dog Lola to Alessandro’s Pet Spa on Melrose Ave, and I could not be happier with the experience. From the moment we walked in, I felt confident she was in good hands. The staff was welcoming, attentive, and made sure to go over the services I had requested: a full bath, deshedding treatment, haircut, nail trim, and anal gland expression. They listened carefully to my concerns and preferences, which immediately put me at ease.

When I picked Lola up a few hours later, I was blown away by how beautiful she looked. Her coat was soft, shiny, and noticeably lighter after the deshedding. The haircut was perfect—not too short, not uneven, but styled in a way that really brought out her natural features. They also trimmed her nails to a safe and comfortable length, which is something that often gets overlooked at other grooming places. It was clear to me that they paid attention to detail and took pride in their work.

One of my biggest concerns with grooming is how stressed out Lola might feel during the process. She can be a bit anxious in new environments, and in the past I’ve picked her up from other places only to find her restless, panting, or overwhelmed. This time, she came out calm, happy, and relaxed, wagging her tail and looking proud of herself. That alone speaks volumes about the way Alessandro’s Pet Spa treats the pets in their care. They clearly prioritize not only the quality of grooming but also the emotional well-being of their furry clients.

The spa itself is clean, organized, and has a calm atmosphere that helps set the tone for a positive visit. The team is professional, kind, and you can tell they genuinely love animals. They didn’t rush through the process, but at the same time, everything was done in a timely manner, so I wasn’t left waiting longer than necessary.

Overall, my experience at Alessandro’s Pet Spa was nothing short of excellent. Lola looked and felt amazing, and I could tell she had a positive experience throughout. I truly appreciate the level of care, attention, and professionalism this team brings to their work. I would highly recommend Alessandro’s to any pet owner looking for a trustworthy, skilled, and compassionate grooming service. We’ll definitely be returning for all of Lola’s grooming needs.
Laury & Maglen where great literary the best grooming my schnauzer has ever had , great experience, the vibe is 🔥🔥🔥🔥 …
Fantastic, I tried multiple places and none came close to the level of care and service.
Frankie had a great first grooming appointment! Alessandro was fast and I could tell he really cared about making her feel comfortable during her appointment.

LOVE Alessandro and his staff! Our first experience with Alessandro was nothing less than amazing. He and his staff are so friendly and did an amazing job on our two terriers. After our first visit he sprayed them with amazing smelling doggy perfume and even gave them each a welcome toy as a gift. He and his team give such a personalized and comforting experience - we'll never go anywhere else!

Dear JiaYi, 
We sincerely apologize for the negative experience you had during your recent visit. The safety of our employees and your pet is our top priority, and we made a careful decision to ensure that both were protected.

Unfortunately, your kitten was quite anxious and aggressive, which prevented us from starting the service. In light of this, we felt it was best to contact you and ask you to pick up your pet for everyone's safety.

We would love the opportunity to reschedule your appointment at your convenience. As we discussed previously, we highly recommend consulting with your veterinarian about possible sedation or relaxation options to help your kitten feel more comfortable in a new environment.

At our business, we strive to provide an honest and memorable experience for both our clients and their furry family members. . We truly appreciate your understanding and would love the opportunity to make your next visit a positive and unforgettable one.

Best Regards, 
Alessandro Pet Spa 
(323)644-4946

I have a mini schnauzer pup that needed her first grooming cut since we brought her home. Having a puppy package answered my question on how young of a dog he worked on. He answered all of my questions when I called. Went over what I wanted ate drop off. I love that there is a play space for your pup to be in when they aren't being groomed or waiting for pick up they aren't crated the whole time. He is kind, patient and knowledgeable.
The cut turned out so good, Alessandro and his team did a great job. :) I threw in a before photo too.

I had an amazing experience at Alessandro pet spa! They did a beautiful job grooming my dog — he came out looking super clean, smelling fantastic, and feeling so soft. The staff was incredibly friendly and provided outstanding customer service, making both me and my pup feel welcome. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend them to other pet owners!
Our cats were covered in fleas and Alessandro fit us in immediately. He was so kind and knowledgeable. Thank you so much!!
Alessandro is incredible. Patient and kind with my two cats. Would recommend to anyone looking for a grooming service!

I recently took my German Shepherd, Luger to Alessandro Pet Spa and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! From the moment we walked in, the staff was welcoming and attentive. They made sure to understand my dog's specific needs, especially since he can be reactive around other dogs.

The groomer/owner Alessandro was incredibly patient and knowledgeable. He took the time to get to know my dog, allowing him to feel comfortable before starting the grooming process. I was particularly impressed by the way they kept
Luger in a playroom while he was in their care.

When I picked him up, he looked fantastic! His coat was beautifully groomed, and he seemed relaxed and happy, which is a testament to the care he received.
I felt that my dog was treated with the utmost respect and care.

Overall, I highly recommend Alessandro Pet Spa to anyone looking for a skilled and compassionate groomer, especially for dogs with special needs. I will definitely be returning for future grooming sessions!

I’ve been taking my dog Ralph to Alessandro’s for years, and I’ve never been disappointed by the results. I know Ralph is in good hands when I leave him here. Always professional and caring. Highly recommend.

Alessandro is truly exceptional! He works wonders with my adorable Pomeranian, Lulu. I always request the bear cut, and he nails it every time. What I appreciate most is his enthusiastic attitude and genuine passion for his craft. Thank you Alessandro!

Alessandro pet spa is the best in West Hollywood and arguably in Los Angeles. Alessandro and his staff are highly skilled and professional with dog grooming of any breed and size. The prices for grooming is reasonably priced in tandem with the service and quality and attention to detail to grooming of your pet and or child pending personal preference. Customer satisfaction is expected and delivered by Alessandro and his team. I highly recommend and encourage for pet owners and or pet parents want the best grooming in town. Look no further. You found it at Alessandro pet spa. Be safe and God bless all.

Everything about this place made me very happy, the staffs very charming and the guy who looked after my Doki handled him super well!! (he's also bilingual!!) I wish I'd taken more pictures of him earlier but my pups feeling handsome as ever and seemed to enjoy his trip!! We'll be visiting here again for the next time, thankyou again!

Cuco looks so cute every time I've brought him to Alessandro's! 😃
His hair feels so soft from the treatment. 😊 …
Awsome place to take your little furry guys to get all pamper they treat them with care and you'll be satisfied 🤗 …
Amazing beautiful space + the warmest owner. Thank you Alessandro! I’ll be bringing my pup back soon

Took Princess to Alessandro’s Spa, ✨and she came back looking like she stepped out of a kitty fashion magazine! Alessandro worked magic: knots gone, fur fabulous, and now she’s the fluffiest diva in town. She got the full VIP treatment—manicure, pedicure, a UV light session, and a luxurious conditioner treatment. To top it all off, she got a toy bag for the road—she’s absolutely purring with happiness!😻✨
thank you Alessandro 😇

I’ve taken my year old cavapoo to Alessandro now twice and have had an amazing experience.

My pup Sugar always comes home cheerful and looking 10x’s better.

I’m not too particular with her cut considering she’s my first dog but giving Alessandro the freedom to cut her hair as they see fit has never let me down.

10/10 definitely recommend. Btw I bought her bday outfit from Alessandro Pet Spa! They have so many adorable options for dog clothing.
alessandro It’s such a fantastic groomer and such a nice guy, great space also! 100% recommend

They are the nicest people I have met. They treat your dogs right and they're very chill. All my dogs have always come out happy out of the place. I trust him with them. So i'm always going to go there

I’ve been taking my dog here for a couple years, I’m so grateful! Worth every penny. My mix dog is very “spicy” and has hated every groomer with a passion and come home traumatized. But not at Alessandro, you can tell everyone who works …
We’ve taking our dog Gunther to Alessandro for almost 6 years. He is wonderful! The new location is great and it has also a retail area with all kinds of accessories and toys.

We are so satisfied and happy with Alessandro!!! Not only was he so patient and gentle with our baby Mocha, he did an amazing grooming job. Would highly recommend to any cat owner!! Such kind service and so attentive, we even got a little gift! Thank you again Alessandro! :)
Alessandro owner is very rude and try’s to steal your money by adding to the prices.
